decision.reason: [ev-518a56c0e2c1] is only a one-line bug-fix title, "scheduling flake due to nodepool readiness". It doesn't name a field, setting, component or behaviour that changed, and it doesn't describe the before and after states. It also doesn't say whether the "flake" was a runtime scheduling bug or only an intermittent test failure. The surrounding Bug Fixes section mixes test-only fixes (e.g. [ev-aa6e55e47c2f] E2E test, [ev-f21609ff075e] zone-id flake) with fixes that change runtime behaviour, so the context can't settle what this one is. To decide the subject, we need the content of PR #6491 or an upgrade-guide section that describes the change.
